FOrbitalPhysical.both_tests_originalHaar_orbital_physical_net.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) [lambda.IsHaarMeasure]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) (q : Fin 2)
  (n : ℕ) :
  have tests := ⋯;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let E :=
    DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
  have c := (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda).haarScalarFactor mu;
  have orb := fun k p x =>
    ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x) *
      (FSmoothCutoff.mask K p.1 (p.2 / p.1) ↑x ^ n *
        ∑' (u : Kˣ),
          ↑(∑' (t : Kˣ),
                NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * x) *
                  NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K
                    ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) u⁻¹ * x))) *
            k ↑((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) u⁻¹ * x) ↑x);
  0 < c ∧
    ∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      have k := DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A;
      have kr := DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A fun x y => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (x * y⁻¹);
      (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), Integrable (orb k p) lambda ∧ Integrable (orb kr p) lambda) ∧
        Tendsto (fun p => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), orb k p x ∂lambda) FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime
            (𝓝 (↑↑c * Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A))) ∧
          Tendsto (fun p => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), orb kr p x ∂lambda) FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime
            (𝓝 (-(↑↑c * Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A))))

FArithmeticPhysical.both_tests_sourceScale_asymmetric_physical_net.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) (q : Fin 2)
  (n : ℕ) :
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let E :=
    DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have rho := fun p => FAsymmetricCutoff.mask K p.1.1 (p.1.2 ^ 2) (LCutoffRegime.sharedSmoothing p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2);
  ∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
    Tendsto
        (fun p => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), rho p x ^ n * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu)
        LCutoffRegime.localRegime (𝓝 (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A))) ∧
      Tendsto
        (fun p =>
          ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
            rho p x ^ n *
              DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A (fun x y => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (x * y⁻¹)) x x ∂mu)
        LCutoffRegime.localRegime (𝓝 (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)))
